statement: An instance reads the staged list off the request path and, with a list, reads a candidate only for a document it lists and samples only a request whose view reads a listed document; with nothing listed it samples nothing and reads no candidate. Without a list kept (no list, or a control plane that does not keep one) it reads every candidate by its key and samples as before; a list it cannot read counts as no list, never as nothing staged. The list only gates: a candidate is still read by its key and checked by its window, so a list read late, or kept by no one any more, costs samples and never yields a sample of the wrong candidate, nor a pass.
guards: runtime:StagedDocumentsTest#with no list kept, every document may stage a candidate, read by its key
runtime:StagedDocumentsTest#a list read gates the reads and the samples, and with nothing listed nothing is sampled
